items.title: Lamar Jackson: Potential game-time decision
items.text:
Jackson (ankle) was a limited participant in Friday's practice and is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Bengals.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Rico Dowdle: Questionable for Paris game
items.text:
Dowdle (knee) was a limited participant in Friday's practice and is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints in Paris, NFL insider Adam Caplan reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Matthew Golden: Set to play Sunday
items.text:

items.title: Christian Watson: Ready for Week 7
items.text:

items.title: T.J. Hockenson: Clear for Week 7
items.text:
Hockenson (concussion) practiced fully Friday and doesn't have a designation for Sunday's game versus the Colts, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.
